title: The community app catalog grew in every direction
summary:
A community harvest of new catalog listings, with Claude fallback routing and clearer app-submission rules.

Dozens of community-built apps joined the catalog, spanning image and video tools, chat bots, classroom tools, world-builders, and more. Examples include Hibiscus for image and video creation, Orchive for apple growers, and a Limnoria plugin that brings Pollinations to IRC. The README’s recent-app showcase was refreshed too.

Requests to `claude` and `claude-large` use AWS Bedrock as the primary provider, with an automatic fallback to Google Vertex AI if Bedrock fails. The change also adds provider-specific fallback authentication handling.

Submission guidance and review categories were revised, and validation now handles names containing spaces, quotes, or @ without breaking duplicate checks. Submissions require at least Seed tier; the tier explanations clarify how GitHub activity relates to Seed and that Flower requires Seed plus an app showcase submission.

highlights.title: Claude gets provider fallback
highlights.text: Requests to `claude` and `claude-large` have an automatic fallback to Google Vertex AI if their primary provider fails. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
